verdict.rationale: SendGrid's docs point to 'official SendGrid libraries' and 'open-source SDKs', with per-language sample code and a concrete Node.js package (@sendgrid/mail) in use. Coverage is thin beyond that one language. missing for 10: an enumerated list of supported SDK languages, SDK reference docs or maintenance status, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
